{{Top|leg}}
'''Kastovar''' was a commentator on [[Gundark's Gear Datalog]] during the early [[Standard year/Legends|years]] of the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]]. Kastovar typically wore a [[Mk 45 Protective Vest]] over another piece of body [[Armor/Legends|armor]] to take the brunt of an attack.<ref name="GFT">''[[Gundark's Fantastic Technology: Personal Gear]]''</ref>
